report.explanation: Fixture suggestion for the keyboard reply.

steps.text: keyboard (Enter) submit chain through the review gate

args.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { if (document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-skills-armed')) { const t = document.querySelector("textarea[data-skill-fixture='composer']"); t.value = 'Reply via keyboard'; t.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true })); window.__fixture.record('set-value', { v: t.value, attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); return resolve({ value: t.value, attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); } if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) { window.__fixture.record('set-value', { v: 'ARM-TIMEOUT', attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); return resolve({ armTimeout: true }); } setTimeout(tick, 100); }; tick(); })

(() => { const t = document.querySelector("textarea[data-skill-fixture='composer']"); t.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), held: window.__fixture.log.filter((e) => e.type === 'held').length, types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 800)); })()

expect.note: V1 LIMITATION (documented, Firefox 155 verified): a content-world preventDefault on keydown is NOT observable in the page world (event.defaultPrevented stays false), so a JS-handler Enter chain cannot be hard-held even in review-before-submit mode. The gate consults + records the keyboard gesture (advisory outcome) and the user's own text posts. Click/form-default chains ARE hard-held (see basic-approve-apply); form-Enter (the default action) is holdable, JS-handler Enter is not.
